title: Reflexive Routine Consolidation
goal: Review all reflexive pronouns, stem changes, grooming verbs, and daily routine sequencing.

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: Review all reflexive pronoun conjugations (me, te, se, nos, se).
Consolidate stem changes in despertarse, acostarse, and vestirse.
Master the contrast between reflexive and non-reflexive actions.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can describe my entire morning and evening routine naturally using reflexive verbs.
